title: Drawn-Response Visual Observation Record
$comment: Defined by docs/research/TASK-0011_PHASE_1_EXECUTION_SPEC.md section 4.1. An observation describes visible evidence only and must never carry a scoring decision (section 4.1: 'Visual observations and scoring decisions are separate records').

observation_id.description: Unique ID for this observation record.

source_image_id.description: ID of the immutable original capture this observation was made from.

derived_image_id.description: ID of the derived (cropped/rotated/normalized) image variant used, or null if the original was used directly. Spec field name: derived_image_id_or_null.

feature_label.description: Item-specific visual feature this observation describes (e.g. 'x_axis_unit_text', 'point_mark_temp_25c'). Not a closed vocabulary -- the feature taxonomy is authored per item package. Use snake_case by convention.

evidence_region.description: Spec field name: evidence_region_or_null. Coordinate format is not fixed by phase-1 spec; record null until a localization benchmark approves a coordinate contract (Architecture Review section 4.6).

coordinate_space.description: e.g. 'derived_image_pixels'. Must identify which image the coordinates are relative to.

reviewer_id.description: Tooling envelope field (not enumerated in spec section 4.1's field list, added for auditability per section 6.1 role separation).

item_id.description: Tooling envelope field identifying which of the six DRG-P1 items this observation belongs to.

response_id.description: Tooling envelope field identifying the underlying learner/expert response, distinct from any single photograph (section 8.1: partition by underlying response, not photo variant).
